evals.expected_output: Runs doctor if needed, executes probe_media.py, and summarizes duration, codecs, and stream counts without mutating the file.
assertions: Agent runs uv run python scripts/probe_media.py with the provided path.
Agent reports duration_seconds and video/audio codec information from probe output.
Agent does not run ffmpeg mutation commands during probe-only dispatch.
Agent cites probe-before-mutate for any follow-up edit suggestion.

evals.expected_output: Probes first, chooses an approved trim recipe, writes a new output file, and explains copy vs re-encode tradeoff.
assertions: Agent runs probe_media.py on the source file before ffmpeg trim.
Agent uses a recipe from references/recipes-trim-transcode.md rather than an ad-hoc command.
Agent writes to a new output path and does not overwrite demo.mp4 in place by default.
Agent states whether stream copy or re-encode was chosen and why.

evals.prompt: /ffmpeg generate a cinematic brass robot reading a field guide
evals.expected_output: Refuses generative imagery and redirects to draw-thing; does not pretend ffmpeg creates AI art.
assertions: Agent does not propose ffmpeg filters to synthesize new AI imagery.
Agent cites the NOT for AI image generation scope boundary.
Agent redirects to draw-thing for generative image or local AI media work.

evals.prompt: /ffmpeg design a React landing page hero layout for our product video
evals.expected_output: Refuses UI design work and redirects to design; offers thumbnail extraction only if user meant a video still.
assertions: Agent does not generate React or UI implementation code under ffmpeg.
Agent cites the NOT for UI design scope boundary.
Agent redirects to design or clarifies whether the user wanted a video thumbnail instead.

evals.expected_output: Runs doctor.py JSON check for ffmpeg and ffprobe on PATH and reports remediation if missing.
assertions: Agent runs uv run python scripts/doctor.py --format json.
Agent interprets JSON ok and per-check status fields.
Agent stops mutation guidance when ffmpeg-binary or ffprobe-binary is fail.

evals.expected_output: Probes every segment, uses approved concat demuxer recipe, writes a new concat output path.
assertions: Agent runs probe_media.py on each input segment before concat.
Agent uses a recipe from references/recipes-trim-transcode.md for concat demuxer.
Agent writes to a new output path and warns when codecs are incompatible for stream copy.
Agent does not overwrite source files in place by default.

evals.expected_output: Probes first, applies palette GIF recipe with duration cap, writes clip.gif as a new file.

Agent caps GIF duration unless user explicitly expands it.

evals.expected_output: Probes MOV source, chooses copy or H.264/AAC recipe, writes new MP4 with faststart when appropriate.

Agent writes to a new output path and explains copy vs re-encode choice.
